cases.purpose: deferred bind failure reports result code and sends no whoami request
cases.oracle: Independent RFC 4511/4532 BER vectors and bounded one-connection loopback peer. The peer records exact requests, supplies predetermined result messages, and checks close/ordering. OpenSSL validates the throwaway TLS certificate in TLS cases. Literal independent response-BER controls and socket short/error-send controls run in the guest.
cases.comparison: Actual client exit status and complete literal BER request sequence, reply-derived text, connection closure and TLS/SNI observations; raw client output and bounded peer records are retained. Server BER, per-fragment send calls, local acceptance and errors, and TLS ciphertext/plaintext events are separately retained; local acceptance is not receipt.
cases.candidate_script:
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/transfer-ldap-evidence-r3.py
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" serve bind-invalid > "$HOME/peer.out" 2> "$HOME/peer.err" &
peer=$!
for ((i=0;i<80;i++)); do [[ -s "$HOME/peer-port" ]] && break; /bin/sleep 0.05; done
[[ -s "$HOME/peer-port" ]] || { wait "$peer"; echo 'peer did not bind'; exit 98; }
port=$(<"$HOME/peer-port")
builtin ldap whoami -H "ldap://127.0.0.1:$port" -D "cn=alice,dc=example" -w s3cret > "$HOME/client.out" 2> "$HOME/client.err"
rc=$?
printf 'status=%s\n' "$rc"
wait "$peer"; printf 'peer-status=%s\n' "$?"
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" check bind-invalid
[[ -s "$HOME/client.err" ]] && printf "diagnostic=yes\n" || printf "diagnostic=no\n"
[[ ! -s "$HOME/client.out" ]] || exit 1
/bin/grep -Eq 'bind failed with result code 49' "$HOME/client.err" || exit 1
printf 'result-code=49\n'
